name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Niva Bupa Health Insurance Ltd is a Tech driven leading health insurer in India.[1]
keyPoints: Leading Insurance Company[1] Niva Bupa is the 3rd largest and the 2nd fastest growing standalone health insurer (SAHI) in India based on overall health gross direct premium income (GDPI) of Rs 5,494.43 crore in FY24 with an overall market share of 5.1%.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 40.1% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.69 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.41% over last 3 years.
